mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (relative to prior 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and declines in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate sustainable economic expansion without inflationary pressure, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST up and CPIAUCSL down) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high labor market slack (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% annually), a positive payroll surprise (PAYEMS) triggers short-term equity market gains as the market prices in improved economic prospects over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high slack periods (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% annually), positive PAYEMS surprises fail to generate positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE down and PAYEMS up) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO growth < 0.3% annually), a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic recovery, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In manufacturing slowdown periods (INDPRO growth < 0.3% annually), INDPRO rebounds fail to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth is positive but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
